# Debug the complete traceback case
_tb_str = 'Traceback (most recent call last):\n File "x.py", line 1, in foo\nValueError: bad\n'
tb_lines = _tb_str.lstrip().splitlines()
print("All lines:", tb_lines)

content_lines = tb_lines[1:]  # after header
print("Content lines:", content_lines)

import re
frame_re = re.compile(r'^File "(?P<filepath>.+)", line (?P<lineno>\d+)')

from boltons.iterutils import partition
matched, unmatched = partition(content_lines, [lambda l: bool(frame_re.match(l.strip()))])
print("Matched (frames):", matched)
print("Unmatched:", unmatched)

# Walk through content_lines
ci = 0
num_content = len(content_lines)
while ci < num_content:
    line = content_lines[ci]
    stripped = line.strip()
    if frame_re.match(stripped):
        print(f"  Frame at ci={ci}: {stripped}")
        if ci + 1 < num_content:
            nxt = content_lines[ci + 1]
            print(f"    Next line: {repr(nxt)}")
            if nxt.startswith(' ') and not frame_re.match(nxt.strip()):
                print(f"    -> source")
                ci += 1
            elif frame_re.match(nxt.strip()):
                print(f"    -> next frame")
            else:
                print(f"    -> exception info")
    ci += 1

print(f"\nRemaining unmatched after walk: unmatched[{len([m for m in matched])}:] = {unmatched[len(matched):]}")
